entities.name: Nightmare
entities.description: A creature type for terrifying monsters or evil spirits created by the unconscious mind, primarily black.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who culls nightmares from others and makes them manifest in reality, believing fear is the great equalizer.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon whose influence causes the House to spawn nightmares on Duskmourn.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A Cabal dementia caster who summons Nightmare Horrors from his dementia space.

entities.name: Ovika
entities.description: A nightmare born from the remains of Mirrodin who built his body from salvage.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A group on Otaria whose dementia casters summon horrors.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A Ravnican guild aligned with local nightmares.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A Ravnican guild associated with a Nightmare Sphinx and Nightmare Demon.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A curse on Eldraine in which Ashiok's involvement made nightmares manifest.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane where nightmares are embodiments of individual fears spawned by the House.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane where nightmares began manifesting due to Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane where nightmares are one of the dominant clades, associated with Indatha.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane where nightmares manifested due to Ashiok.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane with Rakdos-aligned and Dimir nightmares.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane with spirit-like and demon-tied nightmares.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: A war during which Ashiok's presence generated different forms of nightmares.

events.summary: Nightmares begin manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber, often taking the shape of the Phyrexian invaders.
events.quote: Nightmares began manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber .

events.summary: Ashiok's actions cause nightmares to manifest in reality on Theros.
events.quote: As a consequence of the actions of Ashiok, Nightmares manifested in reality on Theros .

events.summary: Ovika is born from Mirrodin's ravaged remains and builds a body of salvage.
events.quote: Ovika was born from the remains of Mirrodin after it had been ravaged for building material by the Phyrexian troops.

relations.quote: the ability to make them manifest in reality

relations.note: the House spawns nightmares through his influence
relations.quote: spawned by the House because of the demon Valgavoth 's influence

relations.note: Ravnican nightmares are aligned with the Rakdos
relations.quote: The Nightmares on Ravnica are aligned with the Rakdos .
